arguments.description: Wardenflame grounded tactical RPG pixel art. Match supplied game sprite style: true 2:1 orthographic isometric camera, top-left light, warm highlights and cool shadows, crisp one-pixel clusters, separated material planes. ONE subject on transparency. No scene, terrain base, human scale figure, captions, contact sheet, shadow painted on ground, smoke particles or magic glow. A complete compact locked grain barn, cool grey fieldstone ground storey and dark oak timber/ochre plaster grain loft, repaired grey-brown shakes, three narrow loft vents and a short hoist beam. Heavy wooden DOUBLE door on the front-left visible wall, one clear central working iron hasp/padlock and iron straps. Modest practical proportions, not a tower, tavern or palace. Two visible walls at the same 2:1 slopes as the style building. Planned foundation is a 3x2 game-tile diamond, about 160x80 native pixels. Whole building visible within 256x224 frame, foundation front corner near (112,205), roof apex above it; generous transparent margin, nothing cropped. Keep all loose sacks, cart, people, parchment and ground patches OUT; these are separate map props. No open doors, light in windows or active effects. Reserve room to the right for a separately authored cast-shadow mask.
